Community Post:

Hey fellow traders and TikTok enthusiasts, wanted to share some key takeaways from the latest TikTok updates. We all know how competitive the algorithm can be, but here are a few actionable tips to boost your engagement:

• **Immersive experiences matter**: Leverage interactive missions, exclusive rewards, and collaborative unlocks to keep users engaged.
• **User-generated content is king**: Encourage your community to create and share their own content inspired by your brand or album.
• **Behind-the-scenes content is a winner**: Share exclusive vids and photos to give users a deeper look into your creative process.

One strategy we're experimenting with is creating a dedicated destination for fan content on Discord, just like they're doing on TikTok. Anyone else have a similar approach? What's working for you?

(P.S. If you're looking for more insights on navigating different platforms, check out our latest resource here: https://www.broadfsc.com/different)
